issues.body: onSelectClass updates selection before validating the new IRI, but increments instanceRef only after instanceListQuery succeeds. If request A is in flight and the user selects an unsafe class B, B displays an error without invalidating A's ticket. When A resolves, it can overwrite that error with A's instance rows, which are then rendered under Instances of B. This is the same correctness race reported in round 4.
issues.fix_hint: Increment and capture instanceRef immediately upon entry to onSelectClass, before calling instanceListQuery, so every selection invalidates earlier work. Add a focused interleaving test that starts valid request A, selects unsafe class B, resolves A, and asserts that B's rejection error remains and A's rows are never displayed under B.
issues.title: Rejected class selection still does not cancel the previous drill-down request

verdict.summary: Round 5 is stagnant: the round-4 drill-down race remains unchanged. onSelectClass still changes the selected class and validates its IRI before incrementing instanceRef. Therefore an earlier valid request retains the current ticket when a later unsafe class is selected, and its eventual response can replace the unsafe-class error with rows belonging to the earlier class. The added tests still exercise IRI rejection and parsing only; they do not cover this interleaving.
